Local know-how

Puslinch properties are different

Just south of Guelph, Puslinch Township takes in Aberfoyle, Morriston, Arkell and the homes around Puslinch Lake. Lots are typically bigger than in the city, many back onto woodlots or hedgerows, and long driveways and open lawns mean more leaves in fall and more mowing in June. We quote each property on its actual size and layout rather than a city-lot price.

Read more

Septic beds and wells. Many Puslinch homes are on private septic systems and wells. Heavy equipment and core aeration stay off septic leaching beds, and we’ll ask where yours is before the first visit. If you’re on a well, watering advice is about what your well can supply rather than a municipal schedule.

Yard waste. Waste collection in Puslinch is run by the County of Wellington, not the City of Guelph, and curbside yard-waste pickup doesn’t reach every rural address — so for cleanups, taking the material with us is often the simplest option.

Travel and routes. Recurring services like weekly mowing depend on how a property fits our routes, which is the main reason availability varies across the township.

Common questions

Puslinch questions

Do you serve all of Puslinch?

Not every address or every service. We serve parts of Puslinch Township for selected services. Send your address and what you need, and we’ll confirm within 24 hours.

Is pricing the same as in Guelph?

Every property is quoted individually. Larger lots and travel are reflected in the quote, and you’ll have a firm price before anything is booked.

Can you mow my lawn every week in Puslinch?

Where a property fits our routes, yes. Recurring mowing is the service most affected by location, so it’s confirmed with your quote.

I have a septic system. Is that a problem?

No — just let us know where the septic bed is. Heavy equipment and core aeration stay off it.

Do I need to sign a contract?

No. Like everywhere we work, there are no contracts and no cancellation fees.
